source_status: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy the brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
verses.display_text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy the brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

verses.text: and to Apphia the sister, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and the Church in your house:
verses.display_text: and to Apphia the sister, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and the Church in your house:

verses.text: Grace to you all and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.display_text: Grace to you all and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: I thank my God always, remembering you in my prayers,
verses.display_text: I thank my God always, remembering you in my prayers,

verses.text: hearing of your love and the faith that you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
verses.display_text: hearing of your love and the faith that you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

verses.text: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective through recognition of every good thing among us for Christ.
verses.display_text: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective through recognition of every good thing among us for Christ.

verses.text: For I had great joy and encouragement because of your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
verses.display_text: For I had great joy and encouragement because of your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

verses.text: Therefore, although I have great boldness in Christ to command you to do what is fitting,
verses.display_text: Therefore, although I have great boldness in Christ to command you to do what is fitting,

verses.text: I appeal instead because of love, being as I am, Paul, an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—
verses.display_text: I appeal instead because of love, being as I am, Paul, an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus—

verses.text: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while in chains,
verses.display_text: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while in chains,

verses.text: who was once useless to you, but is now useful both to you and to me.
verses.display_text: who was once useless to you, but is now useful both to you and to me.

verses.text: I have sent him back to you—him, that is, my very heart.
verses.display_text: I have sent him back to you—him, that is, my very heart.

verses.text: I wanted to keep him with me, so that in your place he might serve me in my chains for the gospel.
verses.display_text: I wanted to keep him with me, so that in your place he might serve me in my chains for the gospel.

verses.text: But without your consent I did not want to do anything, so that your good deed might be voluntary, rather than as though compelled.
verses.display_text: But without your consent I did not want to do anything, so that your good deed might be voluntary, rather than as though compelled.

verses.text: For perhaps he was separated from you for a little while for this reason: that you might have him back forever,
verses.display_text: For perhaps he was separated from you for a little while for this reason: that you might have him back forever,

verses.text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.display_text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

verses.text: So if you regard me as a partner, welcome him as you would me.
verses.display_text: So if you regard me as a partner, welcome him as you would me.

verses.text: And if he has wronged you in anything, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.
verses.display_text: And if he has wronged you in anything, or owes you anything, charge that to my account.

verses.text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me even your own self.
verses.display_text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me even your own self.

verses.text: Yes, brother, let me have this benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.
verses.display_text: Yes, brother, let me have this benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

verses.text: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.
verses.display_text: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I say.

verses.text: At the same time, prepare lodging for me also, for I hope that through your prayers I will be graciously given to you.
verses.display_text: At the same time, prepare lodging for me also, for I hope that through your prayers I will be graciously given to you.

verses.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
verses.display_text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

verses.text: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
verses.display_text: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
verses.display_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
